blocks.tamil_translation: Every trader wishes to profit from his trade. Today you are going to gain more profit from your trade than everyone else!” the Qur'an will say. After that, sovereignty will be given in the right hand of the companion of the Qur'an, and in his left hand a deed for dwelling permanently (in Jannah). A crown of dignity will be placed upon his head. His parents will be clothed in two garments which the people of the world could not put a price on. The parents will ask, “For what reason are these garments being put on us?” The reply will be given, “Because your son memorised the Qur'an!' Then it will be said to the companion of the Qur'an, “Keep reciting the Qur'an! Keep climbing the high ranks of Jannah! As long as he keeps reciting the Qur'an, whether he recites with pauses or slowly, it is all the same! He will keep rising in the high ranks of Jannah”, Hazrat Buraydah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The companion of the Qur'an coming in the form of a man whose colour has changed through weakness is a kind of appearance; he made himself weak by reciting the Qur'an at night and carrying out its commands by day.
(Injah al-Hajah)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِنَّ لِلّهِ أَهْلِينَ مِنَ النَّاسِ قَالُوا: مَنْ هُمْ يَارَسُولَ اللهِ؟ قَالَ: أَهْلُ الْقُرْآنِ هُمْ أَهْلُ اللهِ وَخَاصَّتُهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقال الذهبي: روي من ثلاثة اوجه عن انس هذا اجودها:٥٥٦/١
